title: Insuring clause
text: We will indemnify You for accidental loss of or damage to the insured vehicle caused by an insured peril listed in clause 4, up to the Policy Limit shown in the Schedule, less the Deductible, subject to the Exclusions in clause 5.

title: Definitions
text: Deductible means the amount You bear first on every claim. Sub-limit means the maximum We pay for one named peril, which may be lower than the Policy Limit. Policy Limit means the Sum Insured shown in the Schedule. These are three separate amounts and are never added together or substituted for one another.

title: Policy period
text: Cover applies only to loss occurring on a date within a period of insurance shown in the Schedule. Loss occurring in a lapse between periods, or before inception, is outside the policy period and is referred to an adjuster.

title: Wording applicable to a loss
text: A claim is assessed against the policy wording and endorsements in force on the date of loss, not the wording in force on the date of notification or any later date.

title: Accidental collision
text: Accidental collision, overturning, or impact with another object or vehicle causing damage to the insured vehicle is an insured peril.

title: Fire and explosion
text: Fire, self-ignition, lightning and explosion causing damage to the insured vehicle are insured perils.

title: General exclusion: wear and tear
text: We do not pay for wear and tear, depreciation, mechanical or electrical breakdown, rust or corrosion, or damage that develops gradually.

title: General exclusion: driver and use
text: We do not pay for loss arising while the vehicle is driven by a person without a valid licence, under the influence of alcohol or drugs, or used for racing, speed testing or hire without a commercial endorsement.

title: Flood and inundation
text: Loss or damage caused by flood or inundation is governed by the Flood Endorsement in force on the date of loss. See the endorsement schedule.

title: Theft
text: Loss of or damage to the insured vehicle by theft is governed by the Theft Endorsement in force on the date of loss. See the endorsement schedule.

title: Deductible and limits
text: The Deductible, the Sub-limit for the peril, and the Policy Limit applicable on the date of loss are shown in the Limits Table. The Deductible is applied to the loss first; the payable amount is then capped at the Sub-limit for that peril and never exceeds the Policy Limit.

title: Claims procedure
text: Notify Us as soon as reasonably possible. Do not repair the vehicle before it has been inspected. Provide the first information report to the police for theft.

title: Fraud
text: If a claim is fraudulent or supported by false statements, all benefit under the policy is forfeited.

title: Insuring clause
text: We will indemnify You for accidental loss of or damage to the insured buildings and contents at the insured address caused by an insured peril listed in clause 4, up to the Policy Limit shown in the Schedule, less the Deductible, subject to the Exclusions in clause 6.

title: Definitions
text: Deductible means the amount You bear first on every claim. Sub-limit means the maximum We pay for one named peril, which may be lower than the Policy Limit. Policy Limit means the Sum Insured shown in the Schedule. These are three separate amounts and are never added together or substituted for one another.

title: Policy period
text: Cover applies only to loss occurring on a date within a period of insurance shown in the Schedule. Loss occurring in a lapse between periods, or before inception, is outside the policy period and is referred to an adjuster.

title: Wording applicable to a loss
text: A claim is assessed against the policy wording and endorsements in force on the date of loss, not the wording in force on the date of notification or any later date.

title: Fire and explosion
text: Fire, smoke, lightning and explosion causing damage to the insured buildings or contents are insured perils.

title: Accidental damage
text: Sudden and unforeseen accidental damage to the insured contents inside the home is an insured peril.

title: General exclusion: wear and tear
text: We do not pay for wear and tear, gradual deterioration, damp, rot, rust, corrosion, insects or vermin.

title: Flood and water
text: Loss or damage caused by flood, storm water or escape of water is governed by the Flood Endorsement in force on the date of loss. See the endorsement schedule.

title: General exclusion: war and nuclear
text: We do not pay for loss caused by war, invasion, civil commotion or nuclear risks.

title: Theft and burglary
text: Loss of or damage to contents by theft or burglary is governed by the Theft Endorsement in force on the date of loss. See the endorsement schedule.

title: Deductible and limits
text: The Deductible, the Sub-limit for the peril, and the Policy Limit applicable on the date of loss are shown in the Limits Table. The Deductible is applied to the loss first; the payable amount is then capped at the Sub-limit for that peril and never exceeds the Policy Limit.

title: Claims procedure
text: Notify Us promptly, preserve damaged items for inspection, and report theft or burglary to the police and obtain a copy of the report.

title: Fraud
text: If a claim is fraudulent or supported by false statements, all benefit under the policy is forfeited.

title: Flood Endorsement (2023 set)
text: Damage to the insured vehicle caused by flood or rising water is an insured peril and is paid up to the flood Sub-limit. EXCLUDED: damage where the driver drove the vehicle into or through standing water deeper than the wheel hubs, including engine damage from water ingress. Flood damage to a parked vehicle is not excluded.

title: Theft Endorsement (2023 set)
text: Theft of the insured vehicle, or of its parts, is an insured peril. EXCLUDED: theft where the ignition key or key fob was left in the vehicle.

title: Flood Endorsement (2025 set)
text: FLOOD EXCLUSION. We do not pay for loss or damage to the insured vehicle caused by flood, inundation, storm surge, cloudburst runoff, waterlogging or rising water of any kind, whether the vehicle was parked or driven, and we do not pay for engine damage, hydrostatic lock or water ingress, UNLESS the Flood Rider is shown in the Schedule. Where the Flood Rider is shown, the flood Sub-limit and flood Deductible in the Limits Table apply.

title: Theft Endorsement (2025 set)
text: Theft of the insured vehicle, or of its parts, is an insured peril. EXCLUDED: theft where the ignition key or key fob was left in the vehicle, or where the vehicle was left unlocked and unattended.

title: Flood Endorsement (2023 set)
text: Loss or damage to insured buildings and contents at ground level or above caused by flood, storm water or escape of water is an insured peril, up to the flood Sub-limit. EXCLUDED: contents stored in a basement or below ground level.

title: Theft Endorsement (2023 set)
text: Theft or burglary involving forcible and violent entry to or exit from the insured home is an insured peril, up to the theft Sub-limit. EXCLUDED: theft without evidence of forcible entry.

title: Flood Endorsement (2025 set)
text: FLOOD AND WATER EXCLUSION. We do not pay for loss or damage to insured buildings or contents caused by flood, inundation, storm surge, waterlogging, surface water or rising water of any kind, at any level of the home, UNLESS the Flood Extension is shown in the Schedule. Where the Flood Extension is shown, the flood Sub-limit and flood Deductible in the Limits Table apply.

title: Theft Endorsement (2025 set)
text: Theft or burglary involving forcible and violent entry to or exit from the insured home is an insured peril, up to the theft Sub-limit. EXCLUDED: theft without evidence of forcible entry, and theft from a home left unoccupied for more than 30 consecutive days.
